events.name: Bash
events.head: Check job state, tick log, git sync and plist interpreter
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; launchctl print gui/$(id -u)/com.tantra.ops 2>&1 | grep -E "state|runs|last exit|program|python" | head -8; echo ---; wc -l workshop-plan/ops/tick.log; grep -n "packages_distributions" workshop-plan/ops/tick.log | tail -1; echo ---; grep -n "day_outputs" workshop-plan/ops/tick.log | tail -5; echo ---; tail -4 workshop-plan/ops/tick.log | cut -c1-300; echo ---; git fetch -q origin 2>&1 | tail -2; git rev-list --left-right --count main...origin/main; for c in 0332ee4 8141e8d f842c8b; do git merge-base --is-ancestor $c origin/main && echo "$c on origin"

events.name: Bash
events.head: Survey pipeline wiring and admin sign-in usage across ops scripts
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -n "dayoutput\|day_outputs" workshop-plan/ops/tick.py | head; echo ---; grep -n "def \|argparse\|add_argument\|--check\|--dry\|--one\|login\|admin" workshop-plan/ops/dayoutput.py | cut -c1-170 | head -70; echo ---; grep -rn "admin/login\|[?&][redacted]" workshop-plan/ops/*.py | cut -c1-190 | head -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check board state, run check, dry run and outputs probe, read idempotency code

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run the real day output pass, confirm file untouched, inspect remaining old sign-in callers
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan/ops; PY=/Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/3.12/bin/python3; $PY dayoutput.py 2>&1 | tail -2; shasum outputs/4/day1.html; stat -f '%Sm' outputs/4/day1.html; sqlite3 ops.db "select attendee_id,day,status,attempts,substr(input_hash,1,10),source_updated_at,datetime(updated_at,'unixepoch'),html_path from day_outputs" 2>&1 | head; echo --- fetch; sed -n 77,95p dayoutput.py; echo --- centre_sheet; sed -n 78,98p centre_sheet.py; echo --- dryrun; grep -n "admin/enter\|admin?\|token=\|def admin\|def call\|adm =" dryrun_day1.py | head; e

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the dry run sign-in helper and list any remaining old sign-in references
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan/ops; sed -n 92,104p dryrun_day1.py; grep -rn "admin/enter?k=\|enter?k=" --include="*.py" --include="*.sh" --include="*.mjs" --include="*.md" . ../../app/scripts ../../cloud/src 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | cut -c1-160 | head -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: Switch the two remaining ops scripts to POST sign-in and test the dry run helper read-only

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the Worker sign-in route, the JS sign-in helper and the dry run target settings
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -n "admin/enter" cloud/src/*.ts | cut -c1-200 | head -8; sed -n 8,22p app/scripts/test-attendee.mjs | cut -c1-240; grep -n "CENTRE\s*=\|def admin_key" -A6 workshop-plan/ops/dryrun_day1.py | sed -n 1,22p; lsof -nP -iTCP:8790 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | cut -c1-80

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the sign-in handler and see what the local centre answers
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; sed -n 1038,1054p cloud/src/index.ts | cut -c1-260; lsof -nP -iTCP:8790 -sTCP:LISTEN | tail -1 | awk '{print $1,$2}'; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "local GET enter %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:8790/admin/enter; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "local POST bad token %{http_code}\n" -d token=x http://127.0.0.1:8790/admin/enter

events.name: Bash
events.head: Prove both fixed scripts sign in and read, without writing anything
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan/ops; PY=/Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/3.12/bin/python3; curl -s -D- -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:8790/admin/enter | head -4; echo --- centre_sheet; $PY centre_sheet.py --dry 2>&1 | tail -4 | cut -c1-240; echo --- dryrun helper on prod, read only; DRYRUN_CENTRE=https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev DRYRUN_ADMIN_KEY="$(cat ~/.config/tantra/revops-admin-key)" $PY - <<'E'
